definitions.explanation: A person whose behavior, habits, or thinking is notably unusual or unconventional. Can be used with mild affection or amusement.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{教授|きょうじゅ}→教授：02589_kyouju⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{奇人|きじん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ。
examples.english: That professor is famous for being an eccentric.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{奇人|きじん}だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{確|たし}か→確か：00894_tashika⟧だ。
examples.english: He's an oddball, but his work skills are solid.

examples.japanese: ⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{奇人|きじん}⟦{変人|へんじん}→変人：12111_henjin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれる→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧⟦{人物|じんぶつ}→人物：03356_jinbutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{何人|なんにん}→何人：17593_nannin⟧かいた。
examples.english: The town has always had a few people who were called eccentrics and oddballs.

notes:
Composed of {奇|き} (strange, unusual) + ⟦{人|じん}→〜人：09849_jin⟧ (person). Often used as part of the set phrase {奇人|きじん}⟦{変人|へんじん}→変人：12111_henjin⟧ (eccentrics and oddballs), which is a common four-character expression.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {奇人|きじん}⟦{変人|へんじん}→変人：12111_henjin⟧ (eccentrics and oddballs — often used as a pair)
- {奇人|きじん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれる→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧ (to be called an eccentric)
- {奇人|きじん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧ (famous as an eccentric)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{変人|へんじん}→変人：12111_henjin⟧ — weirdo, odd person (slightly more negative than {奇人|きじん})
- {変|へん}わり{者|もの} — unconventional person, nonconformist (milder, can be positive)
- ⟦{風変|ふうが}わり→風変わり：20570_fuugawari⟧ — peculiar, eccentric (na-adjective describing the quality itself)
